newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra dividend less than expected - Canberra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra dividend less than expected - Canberra.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that further analysis had shown that the government's dividend from Telstra Corp would be A$26 million less than budgeted.
"At this stage, the dividend is running about A$26 million behind the budget estimate," Costello told the House of Representatives.
On Monday, he said the dividend was A$70 million greater than budgeted.

"In the 1996/97 year, there will be a final dividend in respect of 1995/96, an interim dividend in respect of 1996/97 and special dividend in respect of 1996/97," Costello said, without further explanation.
His spokesman was unavailable for comment.
On Friday, Telstra announced a A$1.37 billion dividend.
Costello said on Monday that the government had budgeted for a dividend of about A$1.30 billion.
